name: Tobi Adebayo
bio: DJ Tobi is one of Nigeria's most electrifying on-air personalities, bringing fire energy to the airwaves every afternoon and evening. With over 8 years of experience spinning afrobeats, street anthems, and high voltage gbedu, he keeps Lagos moving on Area Workchop and Area Drivetime-Cruise.

name: Funke Akindele
bio: Funke Akindele is the powerhouse behind Area 93.5 FM's flagship morning and drivetime broadcasts. A veteran broadcaster with over 12 years in the industry, she brings warmth, wit, citizens' parliament debates, and live commuter talk across Lagos.

name: Olamide Okafor
bio: Olamide Okafor is the voice Lagos wakes up to. Known for his razor-sharp commentary, infectious energy, and deep knowledge of Nigerian street culture, he kicks off the dawn with The Early Momo Show (Part 1).

name: Kemi Adetiba
bio: DJ Kemi Adetiba owns the night. Her overnight mixes blend high voltage gbedu, chill soul, and afro-fusion into a sonic sanctuary that keeps nocturnal Lagos tuned in until sunrise.

name: Babalola Alabi
bio: Babalola Alabi founded Area 93.5 FM with a single vision: to give every neighbourhood in Lagos a voice. As Station Director and sports correspondent, he co-hosts the fiery evening sports arena on Area Drivetime-Cruise.

name: Simi Ogunleye
bio: Simi Ogunleye is the musical heartbeat of Area 93.5 FM. As Music Director she curates the station's playlist, discovers emerging Nigerian talent, and hosts the high-energy daytime flagship show Midday Vibes.
